title: Vehicle Purchase Agreements: Granting a Hold Extension
content:
This page covers how far one hold extension moves the hold on a reserved deal under the Vehicle Purchase Agreements, and how the extension is recorded.

## Scope

- **Retail deals asked after the reservation date.** For a reserved deal of any deal type other than Fleet Vehicle Purchase Agreement, whose hold extension is asked for on a day after its reservation date, this policy sets how far one hold extension moves the hold. It does so only for such a deal.
- **Fleet deals and same-day requests.** A Fleet Vehicle Purchase Agreement, and a deal whose hold extension is asked for on its reservation date, keeps the base extension: the deal type's hold extension days in calendar days, counted from the current hold expiry date.
- **Every extension.** Every extension, this one included, raises the deal's count of hold extensions by one and is never counted from the request date.

## Requests

Each request a buyer makes is handled as one extension of the hold; a further extension needs a further request.

## When the extension days are worked out

The extension days are not worked out until a deposit received on the handling date stands on the deal.

Put another way, the deal's records must show a deposit received on the handling date before the extension days for the request are worked out.

## Recording the extension: `extend_vehicle_hold_21e7c68f`

**Capability.** The tool extends the hold on one reserved vehicle purchase deal once. It moves the deal's hold expiry date forward by the number of calendar days passed, counted from the hold expiry date currently on the deal. It also raises the deal's count of hold extensions by one. The buyer sees the new last day of the hold.

**How it is invoked.** The agent unlocks `extend_vehicle_hold_21e7c68f` and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `purchase_deal_id` | The deal reference number of the reserved deal, as returned by the purchase deal lookup for the verified customer | Identifier text |
| `extension_days` | The number of calendar days added to the current hold expiry date | A whole number (integer, no decimals) greater than zero |

**Return.** A reply that starts with "Hold extended" means the extension was recorded. It shows:
- the deal reference;
- the previous hold expiry date (YYYY-MM-DD);
- the calendar days added;
- the new hold expiry date (YYYY-MM-DD, the new last day of the hold);
- the new extension count.

A reply that starts with "Error:" means the days were not a whole number greater than zero and nothing was changed.
